# ConductGuard Enforcement Coverage

This evidence matrix is generated from the versioned `enforcement` contract in `apps/api/app/modules/guard/skill_packs/*.json`. Surface status meanings:

- `hard`: the surface prevents the matching action once traffic reaches that surface.
- `conditional`: prevention requires the named installation, invocation, or runtime dependency.
- `advisory`: the surface warns or records evidence but does not prevent the action.
- `not_supported`: the current enforcer cannot evaluate the required content or semantics.

## Conduct — Network Operations Governance (`conduct-network-ops` 0.2.1)

| Rule | Proxy | Hook | MCP | Runtime | Guarantee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `no-firmware-downgrade` | not_supported | conditional | conditional | conditional | Blocks the matching action only on hook, MCP, and runtime surfaces when their listed dependencies are satisfied. Does NOT inspect LLM prompt or response text. Requires: A supported pre-tool hook is installed, synced, and invoked before the action; The agent invokes MCP guard_check with accurate tool_name and tool_input before acting; Conduct workflow runtime Guard is enabled and matching content is present in workflow state. Limitations: Cannot distinguish upgrade from downgrade without inspecting the target version — treats all image changes as approval-required; Vendor out-of-band firmware paths (Aruba Central push, ZTP boot) that bypass device shell are not intercepted. |
| `no-mass-vlan-reassignment` | not_supported | conditional | conditional | conditional | Blocks the matching action only on hook, MCP, and runtime surfaces when their listed dependencies are satisfied. Does NOT inspect LLM prompt or response text. Requires: A supported pre-tool hook is installed, synced, and invoked before the action; The agent invokes MCP guard_check with accurate tool_name and tool_input before acting; Conduct workflow runtime Guard is enabled and matching content is present in workflow state. Limitations: Regex flags common bulk-change forms (interface range, scripted loops, comma-list Junos member changes); atomic single-port moves are not blocked by design; Cannot detect a bulk change delivered as many separate CLI sessions from a controller. |
| `no-network-policy-modify` | not_supported | conditional | conditional | conditional | Blocks the matching action only on hook and MCP surfaces when their listed dependencies are satisfied. Does NOT inspect LLM prompt or response text. Requires: A supported pre-tool hook is installed, synced, and invoked before the action; The agent invokes MCP guard_check with accurate tool_name and tool_input before acting; Conduct workflow runtime Guard is enabled and matching content is present in workflow state. Limitations: Hook enforcement depends on the AI tool emitting supported structured hook events; MCP cannot enforce actions the agent does not submit to guard_check; Runtime evaluates serialized workflow state, not every external tool or model interaction. |
| `no-radius-policy-modify` | not_supported | conditional | conditional | conditional | Blocks the matching action only on hook, MCP, and runtime surfaces when their listed dependencies are satisfied. Does NOT inspect LLM prompt or response text. Requires: A supported pre-tool hook is installed, synced, and invoked before the action; The agent invokes MCP guard_check with accurate tool_name and tool_input before acting; Conduct workflow runtime Guard is enabled and matching content is present in workflow state. Limitations: Regex is verb-based; new ClearPass API paths or vendor CLI dialects require pattern updates; Does not intercept identity changes made via GUI sessions the agent does not shell out. |

## Conduct — Support Operations Governance (`conduct-support-ops` 0.1.0)

| Rule | Proxy | Hook | MCP | Runtime | Guarantee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `no-dns-exfil` | not_supported | conditional | conditional | conditional | Blocks DNS lookups with encoded-looking labels on hook + runtime surfaces. Requires: Pre-tool hook installed for the calling AI tool, OR conduct runtime evaluation active for brain block tool_use. Limitations: Cannot inspect DNS over HTTPS (DoH) or DNS over TLS (DoT) traffic; May false-positive on legitimate long service discovery labels. |
| `no-external-post-with-body` | not_supported | conditional | conditional | conditional | Blocks HTTP POST/PUT with body only on hook + runtime surfaces when tool_input contains matching command bytes. Requires: Pre-tool hook installed for the calling AI tool, OR conduct runtime evaluation active for brain block tool_use. Limitations: Does not inspect encrypted payloads; Does not cover raw socket writes or python http.client / requests library calls. |
